Hotel.__init__:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Initialize the object with a name, store the provided room availability mapping, and start with no booked rooms." __init__]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> name </REF>: any "The hotel or object name to store on the instance."
        <REF> rooms </REF>: mapping "A mapping of room types to available room counts."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Assign the input value name to the instance attribute self.name. RESULT self.name]
            [COMMAND Copy the input rooms mapping into the instance attribute self.available_rooms without transformation or validation. RESULT self.available_rooms]
            [COMMAND Initialize the instance attribute self.booked_rooms to a new empty dictionary. RESULT self.booked_rooms]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
Hotel.book_room:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Books a requested number of rooms for a guest when enough rooms of the requested type are available, otherwise returns the remaining availability or False." book_room]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> room_type </REF>: any "The room category to book and look up in the availability and booking dictionaries."
        <REF> room_number </REF>: integer "The number of rooms requested for booking."
        <REF> name </REF>: any "The guest identifier used as the booking key."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: boolean_or_integer_or_string "Returns False when the room type is unavailable or no rooms remain, returns the remaining available room count when the request exceeds availability but availability is nonzero, or returns 'Success!' when the booking is completed."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Check whether room_type exists in self.available_rooms; if it does not, return False immediately. RESULT availability_check]
            [COMMAND Within the availability check passing branch, compare room_number with self.available_rooms[room_type] using <=; if room_number is less than or equal to the available count, continue to booking. RESULT can_book]
            [COMMAND Within the successful booking branch, ensure self.booked_rooms contains room_type by creating an empty dictionary for that room type when it is not already present. RESULT booked_rooms_initialized]
            [COMMAND Within the successful booking branch, store the booking by assigning self.booked_rooms[room_type][name] = room_number. RESULT booking_recorded]
            [COMMAND Within the successful booking branch, decrement self.available_rooms[room_type] by room_number. RESULT availability_decremented]
            [COMMAND Within the successful booking branch, return "Success!". RESULT success_result]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: The room type exists in self.available_rooms, but room_number is greater than self.available_rooms[room_type] and self.available_rooms[room_type] is not zero.]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Return self.available_rooms[room_type] without modifying any booking or availability state. RESULT remaining_availability]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: The room type exists in self.available_rooms, room_number is greater than self.available_rooms[room_type], and self.available_rooms[room_type] equals zero.]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Return False without modifying any booking or availability state. RESULT no_rooms_left]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
Hotel.check_in:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Checks whether a room booking exists for a given room type and name, then either rejects oversized check-in requests, removes an exact booking, or reduces the remaining booked amount." check_in]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> room_type </REF>: any "Room category used to select the booking dictionary."
        <REF> room_number </REF>: number "Requested room amount to check in against the stored booking value."
        <REF> name </REF>: any "Booking key used to find the reserved entry within the selected room type."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: boolean or null "Returns False when the room type is missing or the requested amount exceeds the booked value; otherwise mutates the booking record and returns no explicit value."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Check whether the requested room_type exists in self.booked_rooms; if it does not, return False immediately. RESULT false_when_room_type_missing]
            [COMMAND Within the selected room_type booking map, check whether name exists as a booked key. RESULT name_membership_check]
            [COMMAND Within the name-present branch, compare room_number against self.booked_rooms[room_type][name]. RESULT booking_amount_comparison]
            [COMMAND Within the name-present branch, if room_number is greater than the stored booked value, return False immediately. RESULT false_when_request_exceeds_booking]
            [COMMAND Within the name-present branch, if room_number is equal to the stored booked value, remove the name entry from self.booked_rooms[room_type] using pop(name). RESULT booking_entry_removed]
            [COMMAND Within the name-present branch, if room_number is less than the stored booked value, subtract room_number from self.booked_rooms[room_type][name]. RESULT booking_value_decremented]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: The room type exists but the name is not present in self.booked_rooms[room_type].]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Skip the nested comparison and mutation logic because there is no booking entry for the given name. RESULT no_action]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
Hotel.check_out:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Updates the available room count by adding to an existing room type or creating a new entry when the room type is not already present." check_out]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> room_type </REF>: any hashable key "Room type key used to look up the inventory entry."
        <REF> room_number </REF>: number "Quantity to add or assign for the given room type."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: null "This method does not return a value; it updates self.available_rooms in place."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Check whether room_type exists as a key in self.available_rooms. RESULT presence_check]
            [COMMAND If room_type is already present in self.available_rooms, increase self.available_rooms[room_type] by room_number. RESULT updated_existing_entry]
            [COMMAND Otherwise, create self.available_rooms[room_type] and set it to room_number. RESULT created_new_entry]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
Hotel.get_available_rooms:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Returns the room data associated with the given room type directly from the available rooms mapping." get_available_rooms]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> self </REF>: object "Instance holding the available rooms mapping."
        <REF> room_type </REF>: any "Key or index used to retrieve a room entry from the available rooms mapping."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: any "The value stored in self.available_rooms for the given room_type."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Access self.available_rooms using room_type as the key or index. RESULT room_entry]
            [COMMAND Return the retrieved room_entry without any transformation. RESULT result]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [EXCEPTION_FLOW: room_type is not a valid key or index for self.available_rooms.]
        [LOG "The lookup fails because the requested room_type cannot be found or indexed in the available rooms container."]
        [THROW KeyError or IndexError "Raised by the underlying container lookup when room_type is invalid."]
    [END_EXCEPTION_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
